name: Delay, 375 ms with 40 % feedback
notes: CPU, latency and clicks while the delay time changes. Fancy Delay against Valhalla Freq Echo and Deelay (both free; names checked on 9 November 2026) and TAL-Dub-X. Each plugin names its own delay-time parameter for the clicks test. Valhalla only displays its current value, so FancyBench applies and reads back its values. Distortion and aliasing are in delay-echo.json, because echoes still arriving make them meaningless here.
